abilities.critical_failure: The creature takes 9d6 fire damage, 2d6 persistent fire damage and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed as long as it continues to take the persistent fire damage from the hot tar clinging to it.
abilities.effect: A scalding burst of hot tar burns the creature, which must immediately attempt a DC 28 Reflex save.
abilities.failure: The creature takes 6d6 fire damage and 1d6 persistent fire damage.
abilities.name: Scalding Burst
abilities.trigger: A creature attempts to move through the tar

hazard.description: The bubbling tar churns and seethes, periodically bursting in a burning hot splatter of scalding sludge and gas.
hazard.disable: DC 30 Survival check to throw rocks or other bits of debris into areas within the tar lake that are about to burst, allowing the lake to vent harmlessly for that round (on a critical success, this prevents the lake from venting for 3 rounds); permanently disabling the tar pit would require powerful magic or long-term engineering projects (subject to the GM's discretion).
hazard.name: Scalding Tar Lake
hazard.routine: (1 action) The bubbling lake of tar churns and sputters. One randomly determined target within 5 feet of the tar lake is targeted by a Scalding Burst.
hazard.stealth: DC +0 (the tar lake is blatantly obvious, and its effects occur near the end of each round)

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
